intent: One conversation on a document, invoice or task: comments, one level of replies, in-place edit and delete for your own comments, and a composer. Not the assistant Chat. Built on kit Avatar, Textarea, Button and AlertDialog.
useWhen: people discuss a record (invoice, document, task) with replies and @mentions
show the thread for one line or the whole page
inside CommentsPanel for the selected thread
doNotUseWhen: a list of threads on a page — CommentsPanel

title.note: Shows the card header with the count. Omit inside CommentsPanel.

comments.note: { id, author: { id, name, initials?, avatarSrc? }, createdAt, body, edited?, parentId? }[]; replies nest one level.

currentUserId.note: Your comments get Edit and Delete.

submitAppearance.note: soft when another solid primary shares the view (e.g. ChangeReview's Accept all).

onReply.note: (id) => void; focus moves to the composer.

onEdit.note: (id, body) => void. Enter saves, Escape cancels.

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h3 title (or aria-label when untitled)
comments and replies are nested lists
Reply buttons say whom they reply to
the composer and the edit field are labelled Textareas; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter posts, Enter saves an edit, Escape cancels and focus returns to Edit
Delete confirms with a kit AlertDialog
Sending is announced in a status region; aria-busy while sending or loading
new comments fade and rise in on transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not use Chat for people commenting on a record
Do not nest replies more than one level
Do not show more than one solid primary; Comment is it unless submitAppearance is soft
snippet: <CommentThread title="Invoice INV-2026-0117" comments={comments} currentUserId={me.id} value={draft} onValueChange={setDraft} onSubmit={post} onReply={reply} onEdit={edit} onDelete={remove} />
